en-US.description: A full-featured desktop app for Hermes Agent.
en-US.longDescription:
A full-featured desktop app and web dashboard for Hermes Agent.
Manage AI chat sessions, monitor usage & costs, configure platform channels,
schedule cron jobs, browse skills — all from a clean, responsive web interface.

zh-CN.description: Hermes Agent 的全功能桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
Hermes Agent 的全功能桌面应用和 Web 管理面板。
管理 AI 聊天会话、监控用量与成本、配置平台渠道、
管理定时任务、浏览技能 —— 全部在一个简洁响应式的 Web 界面中完成。
zh-CN.name: Hermes Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- [fix] make macOS 26 signing keychain strict-mode compatible by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2315
- build(desktop): bundle Hermes source runtime and fix Windows updates by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2321
- feat(versions): clarify Hermes Agent version and updates by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2323
- fix(profiles): give profile export and import a realistic time budget by @twuijri in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2310
- fix(profiles): harden profile archive handling by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2324
- Switch MCU Global Agent to Ekko voice mode by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2326
- feat(group-chat): rebuild agent runtime and room history by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2334
- fix(bridge): honor model-specific reasoning overrides by @qdivan in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2325
- fix(tts): accept speech providers that cannot return mp3 by @twuijri in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2328
- feat(auth): add MiniMax OAuth and runtime credential refresh by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2337
- feat(mcu): add automatic listening mode by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2338
- Reduce workspace tree indentation by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2340
- [codex] fix desktop runtime compatibility for Hermes 0.20 by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2344
- [codex] repair Windows runtime updates and storage migration by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2345
- chore: prepare Hermes Studio 0.6.37 by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2346
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/compare/v0.6.36...v0.6.37
